platform.account_sessions.description: Portal login sessions of accounts (rotating refresh tokens of the portal/console).

columns.id: Session id (asn_ + ULID); one row per refresh token generation. [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.account_id: Account that owns the session. [text, NOT NULL, FK -> accounts.id ON DELETE CASCADE]
columns.active_tenant_id: OTA currently selected in the console for this session. [text, NULL, FK -> tenants.id ON DELETE SET NULL]

columns.last_used_at: Last refresh with this token. [timestamptz, NULL]

platform.accounts.description: People who sign up on the Velexis portal (OTA owners and staff). Staff identity of the console.

columns.email_verified_at: When the e-mail address was verified (NULL = not verified). [timestamptz, NULL]
columns.password_hash: Argon2id hash of the password (NULL when the account only uses SSO). [text, NULL]
columns.full_name: Full name of the person. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.locale: Preferred UI locale of the portal/console (BCP 47). [text, NOT NULL]
columns.time_zone: Preferred IANA time zone (by value to reference.time_zones). [text, NOT NULL]

columns.failed_login_count: Consecutive failed logins (reset on success; drives lockout). [int, NOT NULL]
columns.locked_until: Temporary lockout end after too many failed logins. [timestamptz, NULL]

columns.version: Optimistic-locking counter, incremented on every update. [int, NOT NULL]

platform.api_key_tenant_grants.description: OTAs a hosting key (hk_) may act for; the request's X-Velexis-Host must be a verified domain of one of them.

columns.tenant_id: OTA the key may act for. [text, NOT NULL, PK, FK -> tenants.id ON DELETE CASCADE]
columns.granted_by_account_id: Owner/admin of the OTA who granted it. [text, NULL, FK -> accounts.id ON DELETE SET NULL]

platform.api_keys.description: API keys of tenants (X-Api-Key). Only a hash is stored; the prefix identifies kind + environment.

columns.id: API key id (key_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.tenant_id: Tenant resolved from the key (NULL only for hosting keys, which act for the OTAs in api_key_tenant_grants). [text, NULL, FK -> tenants.id ON DELETE CASCADE]

columns.name: Label given in the portal (e.g. "Storefront prod"). [text, NOT NULL]

columns.environment: test = Amadeus test connection, live = production. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.prefix: Visible lookup prefix, e.g. pk_live_3fA9x2 (first 14 chars of the key). [text, NOT NULL, UNIQUE]

columns.allowed_origins: Browser origin allow-list (publishable keys only). [text[], NOT NULL]

Empty = customer scope + console with a staff token; never key-only console access. [text[], NOT NULL]

columns.pdf_storage_key: Object-storage key of the PDF. [text, NULL]

columns.supported_methods: Enabled methods (card, apple_pay, google_pay, paypal, bank_transfer). [text[], NOT NULL]

columns.fees_amount: OTA service fees (fee_rules) included in the selling total, excluding card fees. [numeric, NOT NULL]

columns.cancelled_at: When the order was cancelled. [timestamptz, NULL]

columns.internal_notes: Staff notes, never shown to customers. [text, NULL]
columns.tags: Staff tags for filtering. [text[], NOT NULL]

columns.priced_offer_id: Priced offer being bought now (= base, or the ancillary / re-price child); kept while the checkout exists. [text, NOT NULL, FK -> priced_offers.id ON DELETE RESTRICT]

tenant.customer_data_exports.description: GDPR data-access / portability export jobs of a customer (account.dataExports.*, account.delete with exportData). Status machine: queued -> processing -> ready -> expired ; queued | processing -> failed.

columns.error_code: Public error code when failed. [text, NULL]
columns.expires_at: When the cached results expire (SEARCH_EXPIRED afterwards). [timestamptz, NOT NULL]

tenant.idempotency_keys.description: Idempotency-Key records for state-changing POSTs (replay the stored response; reject a different body). A response that carries a token (bookingToken, session tokens) or unmasked traveller data is replayed only from response_ciphertext; response_body always holds the redacted copy (diagnostics, non-secret replays).

columns.id: Record id (idk_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.scope: Principal + environment + operation, e.g. live:key_123:checkouts.create or live:cus_9:bookings.cancel. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.request_hash: SHA-256 of the canonical request body (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED on mismatch). [text, NOT NULL]
columns.locked_until: Lease of the in-flight request (concurrent retries get 409). [timestamptz, NULL]
columns.response_body: Stored response body after the redaction rule (never a raw token, document or card number). [jsonb, NULL]
columns.response_ciphertext: Encrypted verbatim response body, set when it carries tokens or unmasked data; the replay source then. [bytea, NULL]
columns.encryption_key_id: KMS key id wrapping the data key of response_ciphertext. [text, NULL]
columns.resource_type: Type of the created/changed resource. [text, NULL]
columns.resource_id: Id of the created/changed resource (e.g. bkg_...). [text, NULL]
columns.expires_at: Retention end (24 h), purge job. [timestamptz, NOT NULL]

tenant.markup_rules.description: Markup rules: how the OTA turns Amadeus net prices into selling prices.

columns.id: Markup rule id (mkr_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.name: Rule name shown in the console. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.scope: Matching criteria: {origins, destinations, originCountries, destinationCountries, carriers, cabins, travelerTypes, tripTypes, sources, channels, minNet, maxNet}; {} = everything. [jsonb, NOT NULL]
columns.calculation: How the markup is computed. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.percentage: Percentage of the net price (5.0000 = 5 %), negative = discount. [numeric, NULL]
columns.fixed_currency: Currency of fixed_amount (converted when the offer currency differs). [char, NULL]
columns.applies_per: Unit the fixed part is applied to. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.min_amount: Lower cap of the computed markup per unit. [numeric, NULL]
columns.max_amount: Upper cap of the computed markup per unit. [numeric, NULL]
columns.priority: Evaluation order (lower first); first matching non-stackable rule wins. [int, NOT NULL]
columns.stackable: Whether the rule adds to other matching rules. [boolean, NOT NULL]
columns.active_from: Start of validity window (NULL = immediately). [timestamptz, NULL]
columns.active_until: End of validity window (NULL = open-ended). [timestamptz, NULL]
columns.created_by_staff_id: Staff id (stf_, platform.tenant_memberships) by value. [text, NULL]

tenant.notification_templates.description: E-mail / SMS templates of the OTA (seeded at provisioning, editable in the console).

columns.id: Template id (ntt_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.key: Event key, e.g. booking.confirmed, booking.ticketed, auth.verify_email, auth.password_reset. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.locale: Locale of the template (BCP 47). [text, NOT NULL]
columns.subject: E-mail subject template (required for e-mail). [text, NULL]
columns.body_text: Plain-text body template (e-mail fallback / SMS). [text, NOT NULL]
columns.sample_data: Example variables for the console preview. [jsonb, NOT NULL]
columns.is_system: Seeded default (can be reset to the platform version). [boolean, NOT NULL]
columns.is_active: Disabled templates fall back to the default locale. [boolean, NOT NULL]

tenant.notifications.description: Notification outbox (e-mails / SMS to customers, guests and staff), drained by a worker with SKIP LOCKED. Token-bearing variables (verification / reset links, guest booking tokens) go only into secret_payload_ciphertext, which must be purged (NULL) as soon as the message leaves pending/sending (sent, delivered, bounced, failed, cancelled).

columns.id: Notification id (ntf_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.template_id: Template used. [text, NULL, FK -> notification_templates.id ON DELETE SET NULL]
columns.template_key: Template key (kept if the template is deleted). [text, NOT NULL]
columns.recipient: E-mail address or E.164 phone number. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.customer_id: Customer recipient. [text, NULL, FK -> customers.id ON DELETE SET NULL]
columns.booking_id: Booking the message is about. [text, NULL, FK -> bookings.id ON DELETE SET NULL]
columns.subject: Rendered subject. [text, NULL]
columns.payload: Non-secret template variables (redaction rule applies; never raw tokens or token-bearing links). [jsonb, NOT NULL]
columns.secret_payload_ciphertext: Encrypted secret variables (verification / reset link token, guest booking token) merged in at render time. [bytea, NULL]
columns.encryption_key_id: KMS key id wrapping the data key of secret_payload_ciphertext. [text, NULL]
columns.secrets_purged_at: When secret_payload_ciphertext was erased (after the final delivery outcome). [timestamptz, NULL]
columns.attachments: booking_documents ids to attach. [jsonb, NOT NULL]
columns.dedupe_key: Idempotency of sends, e.g. booking.ticketed:bkg_... [text, NULL]
columns.next_attempt_at: When the worker may (re)try. [timestamptz, NOT NULL]
columns.sent_at: Hand-over time to the provider. [timestamptz, NULL]

tenant.offer_upsells.description: Branded Fares Upsell calls for a base offer; the branded alternatives are stored as flight_offers (origin = upsell).

columns.id: Upsell id (ups_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.base_offer_id: Offer that was upsold. [text, NOT NULL, FK -> flight_offers.id ON DELETE CASCADE]
columns.amadeus_request: Verbatim upselling request (flightOffers, payments). [jsonb, NOT NULL]
columns.dictionaries: Amadeus dictionaries of the response. [jsonb, NULL]
columns.expires_at: Expiry of the upsell results. [timestamptz, NOT NULL]

tenant.payment_events.description: Append-only history of a payment (API calls, PSP webhooks, status transitions).

columns.id: Payment event id (pev_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.payment_id: Payment. [text, NOT NULL, FK -> payments.id ON DELETE CASCADE]
columns.type: Event type, e.g. payment.authorized, webhook.charge.refunded. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.source: Origin of the event. [text, NOT NULL]

tenant.payments.description: Customer payments collected through the tenant's payment provider (no card data: PSP references only). Status machine: requires_payment_method -> requires_action -> processing -> authorized -> captured -> partially_refunded -> refunded ; authorized -> canceled ; any pre-capture state -> failed.

columns.id: Payment id (pay_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.checkout_id: Checkout that started the payment. [text, NULL, FK -> checkouts.id ON DELETE SET NULL]
columns.booking_id: Booking paid (set when the booking exists; post-booking changes too). [text, NULL, FK -> bookings.id ON DELETE RESTRICT]
columns.customer_id: Paying customer (NULL = guest). [text, NULL, FK -> customers.id ON DELETE SET NULL]
columns.provider_payment_id: PSP payment id (e.g. PaymentIntent id). [text, NULL]
columns.capture_method: Capture immediately or after booking success. [text, NOT NULL]
columns.card_fee_amount: Credit-card fee included in amount. [numeric, NOT NULL]
columns.card_bin: First 6 digits (credit-card fee lookup via Flight Offers Price payments.binNumber). [char, NULL]
columns.three_ds: 3-D Secure outcome (version, eci, cavv, dsTransactionId ...) for Amadeus threeDomainSecure. [jsonb, NULL]
columns.next_action: Pending customer action (redirect / SDK challenge). [jsonb, NULL]

tenant.priced_offers.description: Flight Offers Price results (confirmed price, taxes, bags, other services, credit-card fees, fare rules, booking requirements).

columns.id: Priced offer id (prc_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.offer_id: Main (first) offer that was priced. [text, NOT NULL, FK -> flight_offers.id ON DELETE CASCADE]
columns.parent_priced_offer_id: Base priced offer this one re-prices with ancillaries (checkout.setAncillaries); NULL for a base pricing. [text, NULL, FK -> priced_offers.id ON DELETE SET NULL]
columns.offer_ids: All off_ ids priced together (Amadeus allows up to 6). [text[], NOT NULL]
columns.amadeus_request: Pricing request body (travelers redacted, payments brand/BIN only). [jsonb, NOT NULL]
columns.response: Verbatim pricing response: data.flightOffers, bookingRequirements, included{credit-card-fees,bags,other-services,detailed-fare-rules}, dictionaries, warnings. [jsonb, NOT NULL]
columns.booking_requirements: Extracted bookingRequirements (drives the traveller/contact form). [jsonb, NULL]
columns.price_changed: True when the priced total differs from the offer. [boolean, NOT NULL]
columns.fee_amount: OTA fees from fee_rules (service/ticketing). [numeric, NOT NULL]
columns.selling_total: Total to pay before ancillaries (net + markup + fees). [numeric, NOT NULL]
columns.markup_rule_id: Markup rule applied. [text, NULL, FK -> markup_rules.id ON DELETE SET NULL]
columns.last_ticketing_date: lastTicketingDate of the priced offer. [date, NULL]

tenant.queue_snapshots.description: Results of Amadeus Queue List calls (office queue PNR lists) fetched by staff or the queue poller.

columns.id: Snapshot id (qsn_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.item_count: meta.count / number of PNRs returned. [int, NOT NULL]
columns.response: Verbatim response (data[] pnrs, warnings, meta). [jsonb, NOT NULL]
columns.fetched_by_staff_id: Staff id (stf_) by value (NULL = scheduled poller). [text, NULL]
columns.supplier_request_id: Underlying Amadeus call. [text, NULL, FK -> supplier_requests.id ON DELETE SET NULL]
columns.fetched_at: When the queue was read. [timestamptz, NOT NULL]

tenant.refunds.description: Refunds of captured payments (customer cancellation, schedule change, goodwill). Status machine: pending -> processing -> succeeded | failed ; pending -> canceled.

columns.id: Refund id (rfd_ + ULID). [text, NOT NULL, PK]
columns.payment_id: Refunded payment. [text, NOT NULL, FK -> payments.id ON DELETE RESTRICT]
columns.booking_id: Booking concerned. [text, NULL, FK -> bookings.id ON DELETE RESTRICT]
columns.amount: Amount refunded to the customer. [numeric, NOT NULL]
columns.supplier_refund_amount: Amount the airline refunds (Amadeus refundingPreview.totalRefund). [numeric, NULL]
columns.requested_by_id: cus_ or stf_ id by value. [text, NULL]

columns.number_last4: Last 4 characters of the number (display). [text, NOT NULL]
